summary: Phase 1 complete. Added two parametric theorems to Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Completeness.lean after ModalSemanticEntails_of_Valid: (1) strong_soundness — takes a DerivationTree-level soundness callback and ModalSetDerivable, returns ModalSemanticEntails FC; (2) strong_completeness — takes four propositional axiom callbacks, a pre-applied truthLemma, canonical_FC, and ModalSemanticEntails FC, returns ModalSetDerivable. Both use 'theorem' (not lemma), have docstrings, mirror section-variable discipline, and use universe u with variable {Atom : Type u}. Sanity-checked by instantiating against K (scratch file, not committed). lake build Cslib.Logics.Modal.Metalogic.Completeness succeeded; lake exe lint-style clean; zero sorry.

continuation_context.what_phase_2_does: Add three thin wrapper theorems (strong_completeness_iff, compactness, weak_completeness) to Metalogic/Completeness.lean. Then convert K's cascade tail (Systems/K/Completeness.lean lines ~262-367) to delegate to the parametric cascade: define kFC := fun _ => True, k_canonical_FC : kFC (CanonicalModel KAxiom) := trivial, pre-apply k_truth_lemma to its axiom callbacks, thread k_soundness via the adapter. Preserve K's five public theorem names (k_strong_soundness, k_strong_completeness, k_strong_completeness_iff, k_compactness, k_completeness) and their signatures — bodies become one-line delegations.

key_signatures.strong_soundness: theorem strong_soundness {Axioms} {FC} {Gamma} {phi} (sound : ∀ {World : Type u} (m : Model World Atom) (w : World) (L : List (Proposition Atom)), FC m → DerivationTree Axioms L phi → (∀ γ ∈ L, Satisfies m w γ) → Satisfies m w phi) (h : ModalSetDerivable Axioms Gamma phi) : ModalSemanticEntails FC Gamma phi
key_signatures.strong_completeness: theorem strong_completeness {Axioms} {FC} {Gamma} {phi} (h_implyK) (h_implyS) (h_efq) (h_peirce) (truthLemma : ∀ (S : CanonicalWorld Axioms) (φ), Satisfies (CanonicalModel Axioms) S φ ↔ φ ∈ S.val) (canonical_FC : FC (CanonicalModel Axioms)) (h : ModalSemanticEntails FC Gamma phi) : ModalSetDerivable Axioms Gamma phi
